name: 旅人
description: 你也不知道自己的来历，但你现在有了一艘船，请尽情的扬帆起航！
descriptionEn: You don't know your own origins, but now you have a ship — set sail to your heart's content!

faq.question: Is Traveler (旅人) good in Sea of Remnants?
faq.questionZh: 遗忘之海旅人强吗？值得培养吗？
faq.answer: Yes. Traveler is SS-tier in the latest tier list, with a unique follow-up attack mechanic triggered at 9 激昂 stacks. Self-sufficient DPS with self-buffing, no team dependency.
faq.answerZh: 强。旅人在最新节奏榜评 SS 级，核心机制是 [激昂] 达 9 层触发追击。自带增益、不依赖队友，是漂流瓶号开局首选主攻。

faq.question: Which fleet does Traveler belong to?
faq.questionZh: 旅人属于哪个船队？
faq.answer: Traveler is a 4★ Purple Ticket crew from the Drift Bottle (漂流瓶号) fleet — the starter free-sailor faction. No faction-lock on team composition.
faq.answerZh: 旅人是漂流瓶号船队的 4★ 紫券船员，自由航海者阵营。组队不受船队限制。

faq.question: How does Traveler's follow-up attack work?
faq.questionZh: 旅人的追击机制怎么触发？
faq.answer: When 激昂 (Excited) stacks reach 9, Traveler instantly consumes all stacks to launch a follow-up attack on the target. This is the core DPS mechanic — build stacks fast through normal attacks and skills.
faq.answerZh: 当 [激昂] 达到 9 层时，旅人立即消耗所有层数对目标发动追击。这是核心输出机制——通过普攻和技能快速堆叠层数。

tierReason: Strong self-sufficient DPS with follow-up attack mechanic and self-buffing
tierReasonZh: 自带追击机制和自我增益的强力输出

passive.name: 时机已到
passive.description: [激昂]达到9层时，立即消耗所有[激昂]发动追击，对目标造成攻击力150%/285%伤害
passive.descriptionEn: When [Excited] reaches 9 stacks, consume all [Excited] to launch a follow-up attack dealing 150%/285% ATK damage

signature.name: 烈焰斩
signature.description: 对敌方单体造成攻击力650%/1235%的伤害

personal.name: 烈火雄心
personal.description: 获得4层[激昂]和2层[战意]。攻击力提升15%/33%，持续2回合。不结束回合。
personal.descriptionEn: Gain 4 stacks [Excited] and 2 stacks [Fighting Spirit]. ATK +15%/33% for 2 turns. Does not end turn.

teamComps.name: 漂流瓶开荒队
teamComps.description: 旅人主攻 + 艾丝副攻 + 懦夫生存，三漂流瓶号船员组合，前期无羁绊门槛，开荒平滑。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Traveler main DPS + Ais sub DPS + Coward survival. Three Drift Bottle crew, no faction gate, smooth early game.

teamComps.name: 追击输出队
teamComps.description: 旅人自带追击机制，配合小斧头的爆发和王女辅助，形成多段追击链，对单体 Boss 战表现优秀。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Traveler's innate follow-up + Little Axe burst + Princess support creates a multi-hit follow-up chain, strong vs single-target bosses.

name: 艾丝
description: 奥托皮亚的冒险家，热爱航海与寻宝的欢脱少女。
descriptionEn: An adventurer from Otopia, a cheerful girl who loves sailing and treasure hunting.

faq.question: Is Ais (艾丝) a main DPS or sub DPS?
faq.questionZh: 艾丝是主攻还是副攻？
faq.answer: Ais is best as a sub DPS. Her kit provides consistent off-turn damage and skill-point generation, complementing main DPS units like Traveler.
faq.answerZh: 艾丝最适合做副攻。她的技能组提供稳定的非回合输出和技能点生成，是旅人等主攻的最佳搭档。

faq.question: What is Ais's role in the story?
faq.questionZh: 艾丝在剧情里是什么角色？
faq.answer: Ais is a self-proclaimed genius adventurer who accompanies the amnesiac puppet captain (player) throughout the main story. She's the deuteragonist and primary navigator.
faq.answerZh: 艾丝自称天才冒险家，是陪伴失忆木偶船长（玩家）走完主线的关键角色，担任剧情女二号和首席向导。

tierReason: Excellent AoE sub-DPS with debuff stacking and team support
tierReasonZh: 优秀的群体协攻，可叠加debuff并提供团队辅助

passive.name: 欢乐永不停歇
passive.description: 对敌方单位造成伤害后，有50%/95%概率令其获得1层[鬼点子]
passive.descriptionEn: After dealing damage, 50%/95% chance to apply 1 stack [Trick]

signature.name: 欢迎光临游乐园
signature.description: 对敌方全体造成攻击力290%/551%的伤害，自身获得[灵感大爆发]
signature.descriptionEn: Deal 290%/551% ATK to all enemies, gain [Inspiration Burst]

personal.name: 最最可爱的玩偶
personal.description: 对敌方全体造成攻击力185%/352%的伤害，100%概率施加2层[鬼点子]
personal.descriptionEn: Deal 185%/352% ATK to all enemies, 100% chance to apply 2 stacks [Trick]

teamComps.name: 漂流瓶双输出
teamComps.description: 艾丝副攻 + 旅人主攻 + 懦夫生存。艾丝的辅助输出能补足旅人集火时的真空期。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Ais sub DPS + Traveler main DPS + Coward survival. Ais fills Traveler's downtime with consistent sub-DPS.

teamComps.name: 女主角国家队
teamComps.description: 艾丝 + 王女 + 茉莉，三位高人气女性角色的输出/辅助/治疗组合，PvE 表现稳健。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Ais + Princess + Molly — three popular female crew in DPS/support/heal roles, solid for PvE.

name: 胡话先知
description: 流浪号的航海士，整天说胡话的预言家。
descriptionEn: The navigator of the Wanderer, a prophet who speaks nonsense all day.

faq.question: What does Nonsense Prophet (胡话先知) do?
faq.questionZh: 胡话先知是什么定位？
faq.answer: Nonsense Prophet is an Intelligence-attribute support specializing in team skill damage amplification and enemy weakness exposure. Pairs well with skill-heavy DPS.
faq.answerZh: 胡话先知是智力属性辅助，专精团队技能伤害放大和敌方弱点暴露。和技能依赖型主攻配合最佳。

tierReason: Niche survival unit with limited utility

teamComps.name: 流浪号智囊队
teamComps.description: 胡话先知辅助 + 爱德华主攻 + 跟屁虫副攻。胡话先知的智力属性提供团队技能伤害加成。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Nonsense Prophet support + Edward main DPS + Tagalong sub-DPS. Nonsense Prophet's Intelligence boosts team skill damage.

name: 索西亚
description: 破晓者的机械师，既是天才，也是疯子。
descriptionEn: The mechanic of the Dawnbreaker, both a genius and a madwoman.

faq.question: Is Soscia (索西亚) a 5★ worth pulling?
faq.questionZh: 索西亚值得抽吗？
faq.answer: Soscia is a versatile sub-DPS in the Dawnbreaker faction. Pull if building Dawnbreaker comps; otherwise Princess provides better faction-agnostic support.
faq.answerZh: 索西亚是破晓者船队的多面手副攻。如果你玩破晓者阵容值得抽；否则王女是更通用的辅助选择。

tierReason: Strong single-target DPS with stacking mechanic and turn-free personal skill
tierReasonZh: 强力单体输出，拥有叠层机制和不结束回合的个人技能

passive.name: 机件磨合
passive.description: 每消耗7层[灵感]获得[超载]，技能伤害提升10%/19%
passive.descriptionEn: Consume 7 [Inspiration] stacks to gain [Overload], skill damage +10%/19%

personal.name: 灵感来了
personal.description: 获得5层[灵感]。不结束回合。
personal.descriptionEn: Gain 5 stacks [Inspiration]. Does not end turn.

teamComps.name: 破晓者阵营队
teamComps.description: 索西亚副攻 + 王女辅助 + 焦面上校生存，破晓者船队三人组激活阵营加成。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Soscia sub-DPS + Princess support + Burnt Colonel survival — Dawnbreaker faction trio.

name: 预兆之眼
description: 破晓者的瞭望员，从圣者学院出逃的'神子'。
descriptionEn: The lookout of the Dawnbreaker, the 'Child of God' who escaped from the Sage Academy.

faq.question: What role does Omen Eye (预兆之眼) play?
faq.questionZh: 预兆之眼是什么定位？
faq.answer: Omen Eye is a Perception-attribute support focusing on team-wide accuracy/crit buffs and enemy debuffs. Key enabler for high-evasion bosses.
faq.answerZh: 预兆之眼是感知属性辅助，提供团队命中率/暴击增益和敌方减益。是高闪避 Boss 战的关键辅助。

tierReason: Strong healer with AoE damage and team shielding
tierReasonZh: 强力治疗者，兼具群体伤害和团队护盾

passive.name: 未来预兆
passive.description: 行动时为全体恢复攻击力100%/190%体力值
passive.descriptionEn: On action, heal all allies for 100%/190% ATK HP

signature.description: 对全体造成200%/380%伤害并恢复150%/285%体力值
signature.descriptionEn: Deal 200%/380% ATK to all enemies and heal 150%/285% ATK HP

personal.description: 为己方全体施加[预兆护盾]

teamComps.name: 破晓者控制队
teamComps.description: 预兆之眼控制 + 索西亚副攻 + 王女辅助。预兆之眼的感知属性提供团队命中率和暴击增益。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Omen Eye control + Soscia sub-DPS + Princess support. Omen Eye's Perception attribute provides team-wide accuracy and crit buffs.

name: 鬼手船匠
description: 流浪号的改造者，恃才傲物的造船艺术家。
descriptionEn: The modifier of the Wanderer, an arrogant shipbuilding artist.

faq.question: Is Ghost Shipwright (鬼手船匠) a good tank?
faq.questionZh: 鬼手船匠是好的坦克吗？
faq.answer: Ghost Shipwright is a survival-role unit in the Wanderer faction, offering shields and healing rather than pure tanking. Off-tank/support hybrid.
faq.answerZh: 鬼手船匠是流浪号船队的生存位，提供护盾和治疗而非纯坦克。属于副坦/辅助混合定位。

tierReason: Solid sub-DPS with DEF shred debuff for team damage amplification
tierReasonZh: 可靠的协攻角色，拥有降防debuff可提升团队伤害

passive.name: 船匠锐眼
passive.description: 战斗开始时施加[结构缺陷]，防御力降低15%/28%
passive.descriptionEn: At battle start apply [Structural Defect], DEF -15%/28%

personal.name: 破坏诊断
personal.description: 施加[结构缺陷]并造成200%/380%伤害

teamComps.name: 流浪号维修队
teamComps.description: 鬼手船匠生存 + 爱德华主攻 + 跟屁虫副攻。鬼手船匠的护盾和回复让队伍容错率提升。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Ghost Shipwright survival + Edward main DPS + Tagalong sub-DPS. Shields and healing improve team survivability.

name: 懦夫
description: 破晓者的侦察兵，但他毫不避讳地承认自己是一个懦夫。
descriptionEn: The scout of the Dawnbreaker, who unabashedly admits he is a coward.

faq.question: Is Coward (懦夫) a joke character?
faq.questionZh: 懦夫是个梗角色吗？真的能用吗？
faq.answer: No. Despite the name, Coward is a legitimate 4★ survival unit with strong evasion and counter-attack mechanics. Viable F2P tank for Drift Bottle comps.
faq.answerZh: 不是。虽然名字像梗，懦夫是正经的 4★ 生存位，有强力闪避和反击机制。漂流瓶号阵容的零氪坦克优选。

teamComps.name: 漂流瓶开荒队
teamComps.description: 懦夫生存 + 旅人主攻 + 艾丝副攻。懦夫的回避机制让前期开荒更稳。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Coward survival + Traveler main DPS + Ais sub-DPS. Coward's evasion mechanics stabilize early game.

name: 跟屁虫
description: 流浪号的火炮手，船长爱德华最忠实的跟随者。
descriptionEn: The gunner of the Wanderer, Captain Edward's most loyal follower.

faq.question: What does Tagalong (跟屁虫) do?
faq.questionZh: 跟屁虫是什么定位？
faq.answer: Tagalong is an Agility-attribute sub-DPS focused on action-economy exploits — extra turns and follow-up attacks. Speed enabler for the team.
faq.answerZh: 跟屁虫是敏捷属性副攻，专注行动次数经济——额外回合和追击。是团队的速度增益核心。

teamComps.name: 流浪号均衡队
teamComps.description: 跟屁虫副攻 + 爱德华主攻 + 胡话先知辅助。跟屁虫的敏捷属性提供团队速度加成。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Tagalong sub-DPS + Edward main DPS + Nonsense Prophet support. Tagalong's Agility boosts team speed.

name: 海赫
description: 破晓者的狙击手，言行精准地像一台机器。
descriptionEn: The sniper of the Dawnbreaker, whose words and actions are as precise as a machine.

faq.question: Is Haihe (海赫) main DPS or sub DPS?
faq.questionZh: 海赫是主攻还是副攻？
faq.answer: Haihe is a 5★ Black Ticket main DPS in the Dawnbreaker faction. Constitution-based bruiser playstyle — high damage with good survivability.
faq.answerZh: 海赫是破晓者船队的 5★ 黑券主攻。体质属性战士打法——高伤害且自身耐久优秀。

tierReasonZh: 可靠的辅助与协攻混合角色

teamComps.name: 破晓者攻城队
teamComps.description: 海赫主攻 + 王女辅助 + 铁腕统领主坦，破晓者攻城高耐久阵容。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Haihe main DPS + Princess support + Iron Commander tank — Dawnbreaker siege comp with high durability.

name: 钟表匠
description: 黑男爵的航海士，神经衰弱的航海钟研究员。
descriptionEn: The navigator of the Black Baron, a nervous maritime chronometer researcher.

faq.question: Is Watchmaker (钟表匠) a good support?
faq.questionZh: 钟表匠是好的辅助吗？
faq.answer: Watchmaker is the premier Intelligence-attribute support in the Black Baron faction, providing team-wide cooldown reduction — highly valued in burst comps.
faq.answerZh: 钟表匠是黑男爵船队的首席智力辅助，提供团队冷却缩减——在爆发队里价值极高。

tierReasonZh: 可靠的协攻与辅助混合角色

teamComps.name: 黑男爵爆发队

teamComps.descriptionEn: Watchmaker support + Little Axe burst + Traveler follow-up. Watchmaker's Intelligence provides cooldown reduction for denser burst windows.

name: 王女
description: 破晓者的领袖，僭越王权的'王女'，海鹰中声名卓著的将领。
descriptionEn: The leader of the Dawnbreaker, the 'Princess' who usurped royal authority, a renowned general among the Sea Hawks.

faq.question: Is Princess (王女) a must-pull support?
faq.questionZh: 王女是必抽辅助吗？
faq.answer: Yes. Princess is the top-tier support in Sea of Remnants, providing team-wide buffs that scale well into endgame. SS-tier in the support role.
faq.answerZh: 必抽。王女是遗忘之海顶级辅助，团队增益在终局依然强力，辅助位 SS 级。

tierReason: Top-tier main DPS as faction leader
tierReasonZh: 顶级主攻输出，作为阵营领袖

teamComps.descriptionEn: Princess support + Traveler main DPS + Ais sub DPS. Princess's buffs enable both DPS to over-perform.

teamComps.name: 破晓者阵营队

teamComps.descriptionEn: Princess + Soscia + Burnt Colonel — three Dawnbreaker crew, activates faction bonus.

name: 小斧头

descriptionEn: A gentle and elegant boy in the Black Baron, but hides a fierce side.

faq.question: Is Little Axe (小斧头) a 5★ Black Ticket worth pulling?
faq.questionZh: 小斧头是 5★ 黑券船员，值得抽吗？
faq.answer: Yes. Little Axe is one of the strongest burst DPS in the Black Baron faction, with excellent single-target damage. Worth the 3-week pity pull.
faq.answerZh: 值得。小斧头是黑男爵船队最强爆发输出之一，单体伤害优秀，3 周保底抽到稳赚。

tierReason: Top-tier single-target DPS with mark-and-execute mechanic
tierReasonZh: 顶级单体输出，拥有标记处决机制

teamComps.name: 黑男爵爆发队

teamComps.descriptionEn: Little Axe burst + Watchmaker support + Traveler follow-up. Black Baron faction high single-target damage.

faq.question: Is Molly (茉莉) the best healer in Sea of Remnants?
faq.questionZh: 茉莉是遗忘之海最强治疗吗？
faq.answer: Molly is the top healer in the Ramble Band faction and one of the best healers overall. Her HoT (heal-over-time) scales well into endgame.

teamComps.descriptionEn: Molly heal + Heige DPS + Gail support — three Ramble Band members activate faction bonus, strong in long fights.

teamComps.name: 女主角国家队

teamComps.descriptionEn: Molly + Ais + Princess — heal/sub-DPS/support triangle, stable for PvE clearing.

name: 黑格
description: 蓝波乐队的疯狂琴师，也是令人发怵的暗巷医生。
descriptionEn: The mad pianist of the Rambo Band, also a fearsome back-alley doctor.

faq.question: Is Heige (黑格) a 5★ worth pulling?
faq.questionZh: 黑格这个 5★ 值得抽吗？
faq.answer: Heige is the primary DPS option for Ramble Band comps. If you build Ramble Band, Heige is essential; otherwise skip for higher-tier DPS like Little Axe.
faq.answerZh: 黑格是蓝波乐队体系的主攻。如果你玩蓝波乐队阵容，黑格必备；否则建议优先抽小斧头等更高优先级的输出。

tierReason: Strong DPS with unique INT scaling
tierReasonZh: 强力输出，拥有独特的INT属性加成
